verdict.rationale: Docs describe a full Helix Cloud offering with CLI-driven programmatic provisioning (helix auth login, workspace/project/database list, `helix database create --project --name --slug --plan`), a public HTTP API (`POST /v2/query`) and MCP endpoint reachable from both local and cloud gateways, plus scoped API keys, rate limits, and multi-tenancy isolation controls — all clearly first-party documented (helixdb-docs-16/17/18/24/25/27/28/13/11/7/31). No independent/hands-on report confirms the provisioning flow actually works end-to-end, and one community comment raises pricing/self-host confusion (helixdb-comm-8) without contradicting the capability itself. Missing for 10: independent verification of the cloud provisioning workflow, and more detail on managed-service guarantees (SLAs, backups, scaling automation).
